tools.name: calculate_inflation
tools.title: Inflation calculator (CPI, 1913 to latest month)
tools.description: Adjusts a dollar amount for inflation between any two periods from 1913 to the latest month the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics has published, using the official CPI-U (or CPI-W or core CPI). Checks the BLS Public Data API live for months newer than its bundled data (bundled through September 2026, fetched 2026-11-03), so it knows CPI figures newer than a model's training data. Handles the October 2025 gap: BLS published no October 2025 CPI because of the 2025 lapse in appropriations. Returns the adjusted amount, cumulative and average annual inflation, and the exact index values used.

from.description: Starting period, e.g. "1995" or "2020-01": "YYYY" for the annual average, "YYYY-MM" for one month, or "latest".

to.description: Ending period, default "latest": "YYYY" for the annual average, "YYYY-MM" for one month, or "latest".

series.description: cpi_u (default, the headline CPI), cpi_w (wage earners, used for Social Security COLAs) or core (CPI-U less food and energy).

tools.name: get_latest_cpi
tools.title: Latest CPI release (live from BLS)
tools.description: Returns the most recent CPI index values published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, checked live against the BLS Public Data API: the latest month, the 12-month inflation rate for headline CPI-U, CPI-W and core CPI (less food and energy), the not seasonally adjusted 1-month change, and the year-to-date change. Use it to answer 'what is inflation right now'. If the live check fails it says so and falls back to bundled BLS data (through September 2026).

tools.name: get_inflation_rate
tools.title: Annual inflation rate for a year
tools.description: Returns the official U.S. inflation rate for a calendar year from BLS CPI data: annual-average change (BLS annual averages, including the 2025 average published despite the missing October 2025 index), December-to-December change, and for the current year the latest 12-month rate. Years 1914 to the present for CPI-U and CPI-W, 1958 onward for core CPI.

series.description: cpi_u (default, the headline CPI), cpi_w (wage earners, used for Social Security COLAs) or core (CPI-U less food and energy).

tools.name: compare_raise_to_inflation
tools.title: Did a pay raise beat inflation?
tools.description: Compares a pay change with CPI inflation over the same period using official BLS data through the latest published month (checked live). Returns the nominal raise, inflation, the real (inflation-adjusted) raise, the pay needed to keep pace, and the gain or shortfall. Works for salaries, hourly wages, rents or any recurring amount.

old_pay.description: Pay before the change (annual salary or hourly rate).

new_pay.description: Pay after the change, same unit.

from.description: When the old pay started, e.g. "2024-01": "YYYY" for the annual average, "YYYY-MM" for one month, or "latest".

to.description: When to measure, default "latest": "YYYY" for the annual average, "YYYY-MM" for one month, or "latest".

series.description: cpi_u (default, the headline CPI), cpi_w (wage earners, used for Social Security COLAs) or core (CPI-U less food and energy).

tools.name: calculate_social_security_cola
tools.title: Social Security COLA from CPI-W
tools.description: Computes the Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for a year with the statutory formula: average CPI-W for July-September of the prior year over the same quarter a year earlier, rounded to 0.1%. Uses official BLS CPI-W values (live check). Reproduces the 3.6% COLA for 2027 that SSA announced in October 2026, and shows the Q3 index values behind it. Covers 1976 onward.

cola_year.description: Year the COLA is paid, e.g. 2027 (measured on Q3 2026 CPI-W).
